rules.text: Seller signature is missing on the assignment line.
rules.whoActs: Previous owner (or Dealer if the Dealer holds the assigned title)
rules.action: Get the previous owner to sign the assignment line, then re-upload the front of the title.

rules.text: A lienholder is printed on the title, and no lien release is attached.
rules.action: Ask the lienholder for a lien release or an electronic release, and attach it.

rules.text: We could not read the odometer digits with confidence.
rules.action: Type the mileage you see on the signed disclosure so we do not guess.

rules.text: Buyer's mailing address differs from the driver's licence address.
rules.action: Confirm the mailing address with the Buyer. No change needed if it is intentional.
